property_risoul.name: Risoul 1850 Apartment
property_risoul.description: In the heart of the Risoul 1850 ski resort, this apartment offers direct access to the slopes and breathtaking views of the Alpine peaks. Perfect for families and groups of friends seeking mountain adventures, summer or winter.

property_avignon.name: Avignon Intramuros Apartment
property_avignon.description: Nestled in the heart of the City of Popes, behind the historic ramparts of Avignon, this apartment immerses you in history and Provençal culture. Steps away from the Palais des Papes and the famous Pont d'Avignon.

property_lauris1.name: Maison Mémé
property_lauris1.description: A large characterful house in the heart of the hilltop village of Lauris. Exposed beams, encaustic tiles, Provençal arches — a soulful interior steps away from the lavender-scented lanes of the Luberon.

property_lauris2.name: L'Atelier
property_lauris2.description: A former craftsman's house fully renovated with taste in Lauris. Contemporary décor, walk-in shower, cosy atmosphere — the perfect base for exploring the Luberon Natural Park.

property_lauris3.name: Lauris House — Coming soon
property_lauris3.description: A third house in the village of Lauris, in the heart of the Luberon. Details and availability coming soon. Contact us to find out more.

lauris.discover_text: Perched on a rocky promontory at 250m altitude, Lauris offers a breathtaking panoramic view over the Durance valley and the Luberon. This authentic Provençal village is the ideal starting point for exploring one of France's most beautiful natural parks.
